title: Item106Disclosure
description: Artifact B of cyber-disclosure-readiness: 10-K Item 106 (or Form 20-F Item 16K for FPIs) cybersecurity risk-management and governance disclosure pack. Wraps the 106(b) and 106(c) draft sections, the material-effects record, the source-trace, the year-over-year diff, and the sign-off. Consumed downstream by the disclosure-committee minutes system, the 10-K source-trace file, and the audit-committee secretary's pre-filing review.

risk_management_disclosure.description: Item 106(b) elements as discrete subfields. Each element is a discrete subsection in the draft.

processes_for_assessing_identifying_mana.description: Item 106(b)(1) draft text — processes for assessing, identifying, and managing material risks from cybersecurity threats.

integration_with_overall_risk_management.description: Item 106(b)(1)(i) draft text — whether and how the processes are integrated into the firm's overall risk-management system.

third_party_engagement.description: Item 106(b)(1)(ii) draft text — engagement of assessors, consultants, auditors, or other third parties.

third_party_service_provider_oversight.description: Item 106(b)(1)(iii) draft text — processes to oversee and identify material risks from third-party service-provider use.

material_effects_assessment.description: Item 106(b)(2) draft text — whether risks from cybersecurity threats have materially affected, or are reasonably likely to materially affect, the firm's business strategy, results of operations, or financial condition.

committee_name.description: Specific board committee with cyber oversight (e.g., 'Risk Committee', 'Audit Committee', 'Cybersecurity Committee').

cadence.description: e.g., 'Quarterly committee briefings; annual full-board deep-dive'.

informing_processes.description: Processes by which the board or committee is informed about risks from cybersecurity threats.

positions_or_committees.description: Management positions / committees responsible for assessing and managing material risks (e.g., 'CISO reporting to CIO with dotted-line to CRO; Cybersecurity Steering Committee chaired by CISO').

expertise.description: Named expertise — credentials, prior experience, reporting line. Avoid boilerplate; specifics matter.

informing_processes.description: Processes by which management is informed about and monitors the prevention, detection, mitigation, and remediation of cybersecurity incidents.

material_effects_to_date.description: Empty array is acceptable when no incidents materially affected the period; the stated determination lives in risk_management_disclosure.material_effects_assessment.

year_over_year_diff.description: Year-over-year diff and rationale per section. Rolled-forward-unchanged Item 106 is a frequent finding; this array captures the analysis.

diff_rationale.description: Why the section changed, or 'no substantive change — refreshed for currency' if applicable.
